items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: I and him used to go out playing guitar and snare drum together.

ctx.x: What did he play? He used to play guitar. Oh, guitar. Yeah. And he's the one who started me out on drums from a little kid. Did he play in any band? No, he didn't play in no band by himself. He started out with a snare drum. I and him used to go out playing guitar and snare drum together. Oh, yeah? Yeah. We used to accumulate money like that, you know? Oh, yeah. And that started me on playing drums.
Was it a real snare drum? Yeah, it was a real snare drum.
